request:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the FIRST supplied image, Episode 06 BOARD_05, a four-panel 2x2 storyboard, repairing seating and camera framing. Output same landscape 1672x941 canvas and four equal panel layout. Preserve exact cream shot badges SHOT_017, SHOT_018, SHOT_019, SHOT_020 in their current corners and order. Keep high-quality 3D family animation likeness.
References: image 2 BOARD_03 is the established restaurant: BOTTOM RIGHT shot 012 shows correct occupied seats. Images 3 and 4 are actual adult and child identity masters. Image 5 is the clean restaurant environment. Use exact identities, not lookalikes. Dan blue polo and LEFT wrist watch; Leo 12 in orange; Ella braids/coral/overalls; Maya plum/low ponytail; Nina teal/auburn bob; Max youngest green.
CRITICAL GEOGRAPHY: one rectangular table. From near empty short end, three seats down LEFT AISLE edge are DAN nearest, LEO middle, ELLA farthest. Along RIGHT WINDOW edge are MAX nearest, NINA middle, MAYA farthest. Both short ends are UNSEATED. Never put anyone at a short end. Camera may move around the table to show exact specified subset; other family stay in their seats OUTSIDE the crop, never show empty chairs in their places. The base has WRONG seating in every panel; use correct shot012 reference.
There are already six water glasses on coasters, one per diner, and six empty plates; only show those belonging to seats that enter frame. Menus cream. No food, no payment, no server, no invented people. Keep warm pendants, right window, sage paneling/oak. Keep original faces and wardrobe; change staging only as needed.
FOUR EXACT SCREENPLAY BEATS:
017 only LEO, ELLA, DAN. Leo separates the appetizer, main-course and dessert sections. Ella says she wants a main course; Dan decides they do not need an appetizer while choosing six dinners. End: Appetizers declined; choices will be six main courses only. Repair: tightly frame same AISLE SIDE three people, Dan near, Leo middle, Ella far. Camera looking along aisle-side edge, with opposite window seats completely OUTSIDE picture. Do not display empty opposite chairs. Leo points to exact menu headings Appetizers / Main Courses / Desserts, as current. Preserve their actions.
018 only MAYA, ELLA, NINA. Maya selects the twelve-dollar vegetable pasta after reading its ingredients. Ella notices the visible vegetable description; Nina leaves space for Maya's choice rather than ordering for her. End: Maya choice vegetable pasta $12, no plate served. Repair: use a reverse oblique view from FAR EMPTY SHORT END, looking toward near end. Maya and Nina seated ALONG SAME LONG WINDOW EDGE (Maya nearest this reverse camera, Nina next down edge); Ella DIRECTLY ACROSS from Maya along aisle edge. Both short ends clearly unoccupied. Maya points to Vegetable pasta $12.00 in menu. Menu mentions vegetables, no actual food.
019 only NINA, MAX, DAN. Nina chooses grilled chicken with rice for fourteen dollars. Dan checks that it is one main course including rice, not two separate orders. End: Nina selects one chicken-and-rice main $14; rice included in that price. Repair: camera at NEAR EMPTY SHORT END. DAN on LEFT long edge, MAX directly across on RIGHT long edge, NINA farther along RIGHT edge next to Max. DO NOT put Max at head or centered behind the short edge. Clear table edge continuing past both Max and Nina. Nina menu rests flat with exact Adult grilled chicken and rice $14.00 line; she points at it. Only three faces.
020 only LEO, MAYA, DAN. Leo chooses the eight-dollar cheese sandwich. Maya confirms he may order for himself. Dan quietly adds eight to the two adult choices without handing over money. End: Leo selects cheese sandwich $8; running choices $34. Repair: Dan on aisle side nearer camera, Leo one chair BEHIND Dan farther from camera, Maya remains FAR WINDOW across table. Use tight diagonal angle avoiding other occupied seats. Leo points to Cheese sandwich $8.00. DO NOT swap Dan and Leo. Do not show other seats empty.
Menu reference exact main list: Tomato soup (mild) $8.00; Vegetable pasta $12.00; Adult grilled chicken and rice $14.00; Cheese sandwich $8.00; Vegetable-filled baked potato $7.00; Children's chicken and rice $9.00. Only relevant portion needs visible print. No dialogue captions, no subtitles, no extra labels, no seating diagram in finished art.
